connections.googleSends: Checks the sign-in code and reads the name and e-mail address; the browser itself goes to accounts.google.com
connections.autodeskSends: Connect module: syncs Autodesk Construction Cloud records and imports files; file content comes from short-lived addresses Autodesk gives
connections.personalAiSends: AI module: users' own keys; prompts go to the provider only when external AI is allowed
connections.externalClientsAllowed: External clients allowed even in fully local mode
connections.stoppedByKillSwitch: Stopped because all external connections are off
connections.oidcSends: Reads the provider's settings and keys, exchanges the sign-in code and checks the ID token (e-mail address, name, groups); the browser itself goes to the provider
connections.oidcProviderOff: Provider turned off under Sign-in Security
